C0296.title: Rampart Defense System Against Web Application CPU-Exhaustion Attacks
C0296.summary: Research presented at the USENIX Security conference introduces Rampart, a system designed to protect web applications from CPU-exhaustion DoS attacks. Attackers can drain CPU resources on web servers such as WordPress and Drupal by sending computationally intensive requests, leading to denial of service.
